items.headline: Bengals nix agreed-upon trade with Eagles, sources say
items.description: A trade that would've sent Eagles edge rusher Arnold Ebiketie to Cincinnati has been called off, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

items.headline: Bengals trade for Eagles LB Arnold Ebiketie, sources say
items.description: The Bengals have added edge rusher Arnold Ebiketie in a trade with the Eagles, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

items.headline: Sportsbook liability Joe Burrow overtakes Josh Allen as NFL MVP favorite
items.description: Bengals QB Joe Burrow has overtaken Bills star Josh Allen as the betting favorite for NFL MVP honors, a development that could prove costly for sportsbooks.
